summary: L-4 lookout house on Eagle Rock in Valley County, Idaho, erected in 1934 and destroyed in 1951; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1951. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: After blasting and leveling, a standard L-4 lookout house was erected; firelookout.com calls it a cabin. The lookout lived in a tent before it went up

evidence.supports: 1934 L-4 house erected after blasting and leveling
evidence.quote: After blasting and leveling, a standard L-4 lookout house packed to the site and erected.

evidence.supports: lookout lived in a tent and alidade set on a rock before the house
evidence.quote: Prior to this building an alidade was set upon a rock and the lookout resided in a tent.

evidence.supports: listed as a ground lookout, gone

evidence.quote: Idaho Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

sources.title: Eagle Rock - Forest Lookouts (Rex's Fire Lookout Page)
Idaho Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Three pages only. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page for Eagle Rock gives no site, staffing or fire history, so it is not cited. Brief's design (L-4) and 1951 destruction check out; no correction. The 1920s camp is in the story but not as a dated event, because both pages give only a decade ('1920s'). No cause for the 1951 destruction is given. Not the Oregon Eagle Rock (us-or-eagle-rock), and not the California ones.
